meta.title: QiQi security triage
meta.description: Adds the QiQi security triage agent preset and the scan-triage skill: triage Nmap and other scan results, vulnerability reports, alerts and logs with risk grading, false-positive checks, and remediation and retest guidance. Includes an Nmap XML summary script and a practice sample. Defensive use only; it does not run scans or attacks.
